senses.gloss:
Timājipaṇḍita
or Tryambaka Paṇḍita of Puṇyastambha, father of Ananta (a. of C. on Āryāsaptaśatī etc. NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 172b).
--father of Mukunda Paṇḍita (a. of Satpadyamuktāvalī. Adyar D. V. 1098).
Prob. same a. above.

Timāji_Raghunātha
teacher of Tumbara (a. of Unmārgabhañjana. Hpr. III. 41).

Timiracandrikā
on tāntric worship. by Rāmaratna. Hpr. IV. 111. L. XI. Pref. p. 15. RASB. VIII. A. 6208 (inc.).

Timiroddhāṭa
in verse. Kāś. Śai.
Q. by Kṣemarāja in Śivasūtravimarśinī, Hall p. 197.

Timmakavi
son of Kūcimañci Jagganāmātya of Kauṇḍinyagotra an. disciple of Devulapalli Sītārāmāntarvāṇi.
--Sujanamanaḥkumudacandrikā. MT. 1611 (a..

Timmajyautiṣika
father of Śrīnivāsa (a. of Haṭharatnāvalī. TD. 6715). [Page179-b]

Timmaṇabhaṭṭa
--Smṛtikośadīpikā. Baroda 2008 (1st Āhnika, 2nd inc.).

Timmaṇācārya_(?)
--Sāmagrīvāda. TD. 6679.

Timmaṇācārya
--Ekādaśīnirṇaya. TD. 18526.
--Tithinirṇaya. TD. 18588.

Timmaṇṇācārya
salutes Veṅkaṭārya.
--Sandhyāvandanamantrabhāṣya. dvai. (diff. from Timmayajvan's work). Mysore D. I. 625.

Timmaṇṇācārya
dvai. writer. of Varkhedi; pupil of Satyavijayatīrtha.
--Aṇvākṣepasāra. dh. TD. 18816.
--Kāṇvamīmām3sā. TD. 18817-18. [Page180-a.
--Gajapañcānana. vedānta. TD. 8134.
--C. on Jayantīnirṇaya of Ānandatīrtha. TD. 18836.
--Paśupuroḍāśamīmām3sā. Burnell 109b.
--Pratyāhārasūtravicāra. gr. TD. 5928 (inc.).
--Brahmayajñakālamīmām3sā. MT. 1323 (b).
--C. on Viṣṇutattvanirṇaya of Ānandatīrtha. TD. 8064.
--Sam3nyāsamīmām3sā. TD. 18984.
--Sādhanīdvādaśīmīmām3sā. TD. 18983.
--Śiṣṭācāramīmām3sā. TD. 18971.
--Sudhānādaraṇīyakhaṇḍana. TD. 8136.

Timmaṇṇa
--Kroḍa. ny. Oppert II. 10230.
--Pūrvamaṇisāra or Anyathākhyātivāda. summary of Tattvacintāmaṇi. TD. 6265.
--Sāmānyaniruktikroḍa. Oppert II. 10274.

Timmadaṇḍanātha
or Timmaya of Sāluva; beg. of 16th Cent.; Prime Minister of Kṛṣṇarāya, Karṇāṭaka country.
--C. Manoharā on Bālabhārata of Agastya. MT. 4367 (a..

Timmanāyaka
father of Kanakasabhāpati (a. of C. Lalitā on Vṛttaratnākara, Adyar D. VI. 775).

Timmapa
See also Tirumala.

Timmappa
grandfather of Rāma (a. of Sannītirāmāyaṇa).
--Tattvakaustubha. dvai.
See J. of the Trav. Uni. Ori. Mss. Libr. VII. i. p. 4.

Timmabhūpāla
or Tippabhūpāla.
See Gopendra Tippabhūpāla.

Timmabhūpāla
or Timmarāju, nephew of Tirumalarāya; son of Konāmbikā an. Obala, patron of Cerukūri Lakṣmīdhara (a. of C. Abhīṣṭārthadāyinī on Prasannarāghava, MT. 2338).
See Sources of Vijayanagar History p. 212 fn.

Timmabhūpāla
son of Timmāmbikā an. Nṛsim3ha. [Page180-b]
--C. Prakāśa on Tattvacintāmaṇi of Gaṅgeśa. MT. 3387.
See above p. 23a.

Timmaya
or Veṅkaṭa, father of Vaikhānasa Śrīnivāsa (a. of C. on Abhijñāna Śākuntala. NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 287a).

Timmaya
(Vellāla) father of Nārāyaṇa (a. of Pitṛmedhasāra, Trav. Uni. 5498).

Timmaya
son of Yallayabhaṭṭa.
--Śāntipaddhati. Adyar.

Timmayajvan
of Peddamallagoṇḍa family; father of a. of Prāyaścittasudhānidhi, MT. 1420 (a..

Timmayajvan
I son of Ananta Somayājin of Mādhava Somayājī family; grandfather of Timmayajvan II.
--Kṛṣṇābhyudaya an. C. Adyar D. V. 54.

Timmayajvan
II or Tirumalayajvan. son of Mallaya of Mādhavasomayāji family; grandson of Timmayajvan I.
--Darśapūrṇamāsamantrabhāṣya. MT. 1664 (a..
--Sandhyāvandanamantrabhāṣya. MD. 2883. Mysore D. I. 627.

Timmayajvan
of Cerukūri family of Kāśyapagotra; son of Lakṣmaṇabhaṭṭa an. grandson of Tirumalasomayājin; became a Sannyāsin under the name Rāmacandrāśrama.
--Ṣaṭkarmacandrikā. MD. 2977. MT. 2214 (c).

Timmayasūri
--C. Darpaṇa on Vāsavadattā. MD. 12419. MT. 3723.

Timmarājakavi
--Vaidyajīvana. med. Adyar II. p. 70b.

Timmarāya
--Aṣṭakavarga. jy. Skt. Col.. Mys. p. 8. [Page181-a.
--C. on Ṣaṭpañcāśikā of Pṛthuyaśas. Skt. Col.. Mys. p. 9.

Timmājināyaka
of Bhāradvājagotra, father of Govinda Paṇḍita (a. of C. on Viṣṇusahasranāmastotra, MD. 9076).

Timmājimantrin
son of Raṅgaprabhu an. father of Narasim3hasūri (a. of C. Ṛjuvṛtti on Kāvyaprakāśa. See NCC. IV. p. 102b).

Timmābhaṭṭa
father of Basaveśvarayajvan (a. of C. on Corapañcāśikā, MT. 1878).

Timmāmātya
of Koṇḍavīḍu in Andhra, of Toḍaramalla family; father of Rāmāmātya (a. of Svaramelakalānidhi, ed. Annamalai Uni. 1932).

Timmārya
father of Lakṣmaṇa Paṇḍita (a. of Tantravilāsa. mīm. Adyar D. IX. 304).
